author: Borzy
subject: Please Fix Reckoning
content_md:
Reckoning only being able to store 1 extra swing only is extremely stupid.  It’s a 5 talent point skill. If you want to make it 1 swing only, make it a 1 talent skill.

The excuse of needing it to be nerfed to balance for PVP is insanely stupid.  “Balance” really is a slur when it comes to RPG.  Each class is supposed to have its own quirk.  If you had to balance it so badly then I ask you, as a paladin main since vanilla in 2004, where is my wing-clip or rend? Where is my “zealots charge” that acts like a warriors charge?  Paladins literally have ZERO closers. Anyone losing an open PVP fight to a paladin is already playing their class wrong.

The outcome is to have completely ruined the vanilla “cookie-cutter” pally build of AOE grinding.  You’re supposed to be able to pull a pack, consecrate, heal your way through the damage while reckoning stacks, and then release it to mow the mobs down one at a time.

Even if you increased proc chance to be like redoubt, where it procs off any damage, the one swing limit still makes it useless so you can’t AOE grind, because at the end of your endlessly interrupted heal, you still only do one swing, so you’re relying on the pittance of damage from consecration.

If you want to change the meta of paladins so dramatically, you need to keep the AOE grind ability by dramatically increase damage of consecration, and make it so that Blessing of Sanctuary reflect a % of ANY damage taken, as opposed to the current pittance of a chance of holy damage only you block.

Please, why did you break the paladin so badly? Why turn paladin from the C-tier levelers they were to F-tier?

The sentiment that reckoning is a weak talent i can somewhat understand.
But for aoe levelling the talent isnt really any worse. You rarely get crit twice in a row. So unless you do get crit twice between two of your own strikes, reckoning is exactly as strong as it is supposed to be. Also paladin got many other boons for easier aoe farming. Better scaling consecration, access to it without speccing into it, massive mana regeneration from shieldspec and earlier access to holy shield all boost your killspeed. While the buff to redoubt keeps you alife much longer than in classic.

The only situation where you wanna charge up stacks is specifically to cheese fights or pvp.

Also remember, in classic in general talents that proc on getting crit do not work while you sit down. That's a thing that only came with TBC. So you can't just fish for a bunch of crits before finishing the last mob of a pack off with a 4x multihit.

author: Kairion
subject: Re: Please Fix Reckoning
content_md:
The average mob hits you every 2seconds with a 5% chance to crit. That means he crits you on average ever 40 seconds. You need 10mobs to get your average 2 extra attacks in an 8 second window. You struggle to even pull that many mobs at once in the open world. And if you do they are likely a bit lower level than you, lowering their chance to crit you.

So yout scenario where you gain more than 1 extra attack stored up before you attack is rare. And even then it only happens when you deliberately not make use of pushback protection so you are casting for longer. Loosing you regular auto attacks in the process.

That isnt a core aspect of the aoe grinding playstile that is playing it wrong.

So ill instead focus on the pvp argument.
Holy strike improves your next auto attack by a dmg value that is about doubling it (considering its armor ignoring property and some bonus dmg)

That means you can basically treat it like one attacks worth of reckoning (with some upsides and drawbacks)

Reckoning had to be nerfed because paladin had BOTH, Holy strike which itselfs deals a ton of damage AND reckoning.

So reckoning got nerfed so you couldnt straight up oneshot everything anymore wirh 4 stored attacks + holy strike combo. If you play your character to 60 you will realize the class is plenty strong without it and reckoning in its buffed form would be complete overkill.

What we have now is basically the same burst dmg when we connect with someone without reckoning as we had with one stack of reckoning previously (if not more) the only situation where you are worse of now is the 4 stack scenario. But realistically you either would farm up the stacks on npcs beforehand or be dead to their kiting dmg at that point. So not really a loss

author: Jstansberry
subject: Thoughts on upcoming Paladin nerf
content_md:
My current opinion of the "nerf" for paladins is that it's not going in the right direction - Paladins are having more fun doing damage they couldn't do before. Vanilla Paladin pvp has always been somewhat of a meme - bubble, LoH, Flash of Light spam - it's an arduous and tiresome ordeal for both parties involved and the addition of Holy Strike offers a path of redemption for the class in terms of pvp. Because of this I think the defensive capability or cc of Paladins should be nerfed instead, maybe reducing bubble duration to 5/6s instead of 10/12s rather than the planned change of swapping the attack speed reduction with damage reduction - or just make it so that Paladins can be disabled/otherwise debuffed/purged in Divine Shield and give them full attack speed and damage.

The problem right now is that Paladins can run 8% faster than you at all times while having 12s of unpurgable immunity to damage and disables paired with their newly granted potential to hit you with a 1k (non crit) Holy Strike in preraid+AV Hammer gear. Then they have Repentance and Hammer of Justice to control you if you survive their bubble duration. So you can't kite them, run from them, or fight back in any way while they are easily able to kill you within this time frame unless you get lucky - and it's a struggle even when you survive those 12s because they have a CC potential nearly on par with rogues. They are unkitable unstoppable persistence-hunter JUGGERNAUTS that hit as hard as an arms Warrior - 12s of no counterplay with the burst potential to easily secure the fight if not outright kill you within those 12s. This is unfun and moreso frustrating for people who are fighting Paladins.

The current nerf they have slated for Paladins isn't fun for either Paladins OR their victims, IMO - it just undoes most of what adding Holy Strike and Crusader Strike did for them in pvp. I think nerfing their defensive capability or CC would be a better way to balance things rather than going after their newly-found ability to blow people up (without cheesing Reckoning procs). That said, for them to keep their current burst capability in bubble would call for a BIG nerf in other areas - thus the example of the drastic reduction in Divine Shield duration.

And no, Shamans are not comparable to Paladins. Shamans do not have 12s of invulnerability to all damage and CC, Shamans have no stuns or hard CC of any kind (barring the newly added Troll-exclusive racial spell which has a 6 minute CD), Shamans wear mail instead of plate, Shamans do not have BoF or Cleanse. Shamans have Purge and that's 99% of the reason why Paladins don't like Shamans and reflexively complain about Shaman burst whenever Paladin nerfs are discussed - but you can't purge a bubbled Paladin and now Paladins can easily kill someone within that 12s bubble. Vanilla PVP is a rock-paper-scissors scenario for most match-ups when it comes to pvp class balance, and Paladins no longer have a hard counter because they can just kill the classes that used to counter them within bubble duration - but we also don't need to return to form and make Paladins incredibly boring to both pvp as and against.

content_md:
> **Infinus wrote: Sat Aug 19, 2023 11:39 pm**
> This. People aren't used to paladins being able to kill them and they want to roll mage, war, or rogue and kill everyone 100% of the time.
>
>  Bubble? It's a 5 minute cool down. Rogues can just vanish every couple of minutes or gouge and run/stealth every 20 seconds. That is FAR more OP than bubble.
>
>  Makes can Ice block and wait for all of their cds too.

Paladins have too much of everything, is my point. They have high survivability, CC, utility, and now they have big burst damage as well. A preraid BiS ret paladin can kill most classes within a Hammer of Justice stun duration, let alone a bubble duration. Before paladins were granted the ability to do good damage they won by attrition - purges and mana drains/burns were the best way to play against paladins because of this. Now, that purge/drain counterplay is no longer relevant because you just die before you can use your spells. Does it really sound fair to give paladins the same burst potential as an arms warrior while keeping their utility, CC, and survivability?

It's true that ret and prot needed some help in pve, but paladins were already good in pvp and the addition of CS and Holy Strike pushed the class above all others in that regard.

I think it's disingenuous to compare Vanish to Divine Shield, Vanish doesn't dispel all debuffs and make you completely immune to everything while still allowing you to attack. Vanish is for giving the rogue another chance to use openers or to simply flee. Rogues have an actual weakness - if they don't get the opening they have a severe disadvantage. Mage's ice block is a double-edged sword because the enemy can also use it to bandage, get their own cds back, lay hunter traps et cetera. As it is right now, paladins just have "I win" buttons, and it's delusional to believe otherwise. I think you'd have a hard time comparing ANY class to what paladins are capable of in pvp right now - because all other classes have legitimate weaknesses/counters other than their cooldowns already being used...

author: Kairion
subject: Re: Thoughts on upcoming Paladin nerf
content_md:
Paladins cant run 8% faster than anyone else. The speedbonus does not stack with boots enchant!

Similarly how do people keep being suprised that getting into melee with a two hand wielding melee hurts? Enhancement shaman, arms warrior, and reckoning paladin back in classic are all well known to oneshot people in pvp. Yet paladins oneshot was flat out removed for more consistent dmg output with holy strike.

Every time someone complains about getting oneshot by a paladin on turtle wow, it can be put into one of the following categories:
 - Paladin has berserking (double dips dmg bonus on holy strike and is a legitemate big)
 - Paladin is heavily overgeared (welcome to classic pvp, thats intentional)
 - You are a clothie (why the hell are you in his melee range?)

There are definitely things in the game that make paladin strong (certain lifesteal weapons for instance) or the bug with berserking, but nerfing paladin is treating the symptom rather than the root problem.

In the mean time, if you need a sidewheel to learn how to fight paladins, grab some [https://www.wowhead.com/classic/item=43 ... ulator-ray](https://www.wowhead.com/classic/item=4388/discombobulator-ray)

"It slows, dismounts and turns your target into an ugly green child"
 -Nexius

Its a slow paladins and gets them off the mount before they reach you and best of all, since its a curse and a transformation, they have to bubble or cant get rid of it.

author: Ironfoe101
subject: Reckoning Bomb- An overview of the temperamental talent.
content_md:
I’ve seen a lot of conflicting, and after testing, incorrect information about the Reckoning talent on Turtlewow.  So I set out to compile a list of what does and does not lose your charges, to help people who want to use Reckoning get better use out of it.  Also to help sniff out exactly what is buggy for bug reports since ‘does not work’ is not helpful.

Most of these I’ve tested multiple times to try and ensure I got consistent results.  However practical applications in World PvP, BGs, and Duels carry a great deal of variables that can make it feel like it doesn’t work at all.  Hopefully by breaking it down bit by bit we can better understand why it breaks.

How to gain Stacks
 -Get crit.
 -Yes this includes crits from spells.
 -Also you can sit crit if you time it right.
 -Seriously.
 -You can get full 5 attack stack.  Please understand you still can.

Things that do NOT lose your charges.
 -Spell casting (Like healing yourself or starting a seal)
 -Being interrupted (Kick)
 -Being Stunned
 -Being Incapacitated (Gogue)
 -Being Disoriented (Blind)
 -Using a buff trinket (Zandalarian Hero Charm)
 -Using a head item (Like Goblin Rocket Helm)
 -Having an Auto attack started (You can stack Reckoning charging while attempting to auto attack a target, as long as you do not swap targets, or stop the auto attack attempt)
 -Swapping targets while not Auto attacking
 -Dismounting
 -Attempting to mount. (If you start the cast and cancel it.)
 -Entering a Duel

Things that DO lose your charges
 -A Duel ending.  (Win or lose.  Concede/Flee/HP loss)
 -Mounting (As in completing the cast for mounting.)
 -Swapping weapons.
 -Starting an Auto attack and ending it.
 -Starting an Auto attack and swapping targets.

Please suggest further situations that can be tested, and if you find something contradictory with your personal experience please share.  If you do, I would be grateful if you shared what addons you were using so strange interactions can be found.

Edits: Clarified that you can get full Reckoning stacks.
 -Changed Mounting as I did more tests related to it.
 -Added entering a duel does not lose charges.

author: Kobiq
subject: Fix Protection but very simple
content_md:
There are numerous threads on "fixing" prot, but in fact people are just not realizing that it's already possible to tank up to Naxx and suggest exaggerated changes. IMHO, Warriors should still be prime vanilla tanks and Paladins and Druids should be situational raid offtanks. That being said, protection tree still looks the least prompting, especially in PVP. What I suggest to address that is:

 - make Improved Devotion Aura also increase Resistance Auras by 25% (from 60 to 75)
 - make Improved Hammer of Justice reduce the cooldown to 30 sec instead 45
 - Ardent Defender: reduces dmg taken by the target by 10% and the paladin by 20% for 20 sec. 2 min cooldown.

Adds utility for PVP support spec as well as some nice paladin-lore-wise utility in raids.

PS.
Inb4 "nerf paladin" drama. To me it's totally fine to remove all bubles besides BoP (to preserve the iconic support mechanic) and compensate in other ways.

author: Kairion
subject: Re: Fix Protection but very simple
content_md:
I have to point out that neither of these changes actually fixes a substantial problem with protection paladin.

improved Devotion aura is a garbage talent, But stronger resistence auras isn't particularly useful for a tank paladin. If a fight requires a tank with elemental resistences, thats usually taken care of by gear mostly. 15 more resistance is a drop in an ocean. Additionally redoubt is the prefered talent of choice because it's actually good.

Improved hammer of justice once again does not fix problem for Prot paladin appart from maybe stunning a mob if no taunt is available. But the spell can already be lowered to 35 seconds CD with the talent and PvP gear. (And there is a libram coming for 1.17 which shaves off another 5 seconds). That drastically buffs pvp for paladins, but doesn't really solve his weaknesses in PvE appart from giving him a strong interrupt. Something he isn't supposed to have anyway.

The current ardent defender might as well not exist. Its not good. But i don't think this rework would change that much. 20% dmg reduction for 20 seconds on a 2 min cooldown would help shore up some defenses, but it has to compete with vengeance. A talent that almost single handedly carries paladins raid threat generation.

Paladins actual problems are lack of dedicated gear and as a result, inability to get crit immune under realistic circumstances (that might change in 1.17)
Trouble sustaining mana particularly in early raid environment with blue gear.
A taunt that shares CD with one of your best threat abilities
Taunting removing your main source of manamanagement without other paladins support

author: Jrobz
subject: Re: Fix Protection but very simple
content_md:
Kobiq, I can appreciate that for sure. I can even appreciate the more designated Niche and utility OT role for Prot in Raids. Also they may well be the best small group tank. I'm good with this. I can say this while also telling you the toolkit is still rather broken. I played and tanked on a Warrior in actual Vanilla through Naxx, and a Prot Pal through BWL on Classic. There is a reason this is one of the more tinkered classes in TWoW. I don't think a full rework of this is in order but more tuning the toolkit to drive the role and scale to gearing TWoW is adding and modding. I actually like the Taunt on JoJ idea. It's not as natural as the Warrior taunt, but shouldn't be. It also fit well into the Vanilla usage of JoJ (turn runners back around - aka hey look at me again).

I do think there should be role driven benefits to going deep into the Prot tree (or any tree for that matter) and that end talents should be spec defining (Best Vanilla example is Warrior and I think TWoW did a good job cleaning up Priest and Druid). I really hate seeing meh End Talents and the TWoW Paladin has 2 (Prot and Ret). The challenge of any reworking is to keep the classes unique in the Vanilla style but right the wrongs of classes left unfinished by Blizzard.

I think TWoW has a really good opportunity to get so many things right.

author: Mativh
subject: Re: Fix Protection but very simple
content_html:
Lets address the issues prot palas have by doubling down on the fact that they are a jack of all trades, master of none.
Protection Paladins have a potential to be an interesting hybrid class:

- Shield Specialization restores 4% mana instead of 2%

- New talent next to One Handed Weapon talent, with Blessing of Sanctuary as a prereq;
Sacred Vow: Whenever you heal yourself, 30% of it also heals targets affected by your Blessing of Sanctuary, this generates high threat.

- Ardent Defender rework:
When you have less than 35% health, the casting time of Holy Light and Flash of Light is decreased by 0.5 sec when used on self.

- New Ability talent, next to Ardent Defender, with Ardent Defender as prereq;
Zealous Sacrifice: turn on manually or toggle it to automatically turn on when available (like pet abilities), it becomes available when health is below 35% and switches off if health is above 35%;
Your attack power and attack speed are increased by 20%, but 20% of the physical damage you deal costs you your health (is reflected back to you), if this damage kills you, your party members gain the equivalent of 20% of your total health in the form of a damage absorb for 15 seconds.

content_html:
Lets address the issues prot palas have by doubling down on the fact that they are a jack of all trades, master of none.
Protection Paladins have a potential to be an interesting hybrid class:

- Shield Specialization restores 4% mana instead of 2%

- New talent next to One Handed Weapon talent, with Blessing of Sanctuary as a prereq;
Sacred Vow: Whenever you heal yourself, 30% of it also heals targets affected by your Blessing of Sanctuary, this generates high threat.

- Ardent Defender rework:
When you have less than 35% health, the casting time of Holy Light and Flash of Light is decreased by 0.5 sec when used on self.

- New Ability talent, next to Ardent Defender, with Ardent Defender as prereq;
Zealous Sacrifice: turn on manually or toggle it to automatically turn on when available (like pet abilities), it becomes available when health is below 35% and switches off if health is above 35%;
Your attack power and attack speed are increased by 20%, but 20% of the physical damage you deal costs you your health (is reflected back to you), if this damage kills you, your party members gain the equivalent of 20% of your total health in the form of a damage absorb for 15 seconds.

Incentivizing healing yourself while tanking is bad gameplay. You give us all your ability to defend yourself while casting.

author: Jrobz
subject: Re: Fix Protection but very simple
content_md:
There are Ret Paladins Tanking, you mean. I think we can all appreciate there are significant issues to fix.

Having played both tanks in end game raiding (Warrior and Paladin), my list of recommended changes will not dethrone the Warrior from the goto MT. They simply take less DMG and do more single target threat. What it could do is shrink that gap and add some spice to the bottom of the Prot Tree that is obviously not compelling enough.

The Prot Pal is very shield/block focused. The way the mechanic works, it will not be as effective at reducing large hits as small. It's MUCH better at many small hits than few large ones. Access to +Def, Armor, Health, and Defensive Stance are all tools that ensure the Warrior is the best boss MT in Vanilla. The Itemization of Prot Pal and Toolkit will always put him behind the Warrior for this. They do have ways they excel, and offer some neat play style though. I would hope TWoW, who is trying to fix the classes left unfinished, would not be ok with a glass ceiling of T2 for the Prot spec.

author: Poggo
subject: Re: Fix Protection but very simple
content_md:
Dethroning warrior tanks is a moot argument, they have better offensive and defensive cds than anyone, 3 taunts, shield block gives them crit/crush immunity on most bosses simply for wearing a shield, insane single target threat, good itemization and a cozy 10% dmg reduction on top.

Moving on.

Prot pallies have had a lot of issues fixed on this server already, but it still falls short in two (vital) aspects that kind of go hand in hand, itemization and crit immunity.
You simply can't tank a lot of bosses because you risk getting one shot/combo's by breath/nuke/cleave+auto, and you can't reach def cap without wearing some truly awful gear for the spec, nor do you have survival of the fittest/shield block to deal with crits and crushes.

You could go multiple routes to tackle the above, personally I think reworking ardent defender to mitigate crits and crushing somehow and adding some pieces, perhaps a 3-5 set that is just stamina, spell power and avoidance stats, I don't know I'm no stat weight specialist

As for ardent defender as I understand it, currently it reduces all damage taken while below 35% by 25%. This causes a number of issues which generally boil down to - it will rarely actually have an impact because you're either getting killed through it or taking so low damage that it doesn't really matter that much.

If it was possible to code it like the dk talent in wotlk - will of the necropolis, which reduces the dmg taken by any attack below or that would bring you below the threshold  I think that would be an option, though I'm not sure if that's enough to mitigate a crit without world buffs to beef up hp from a boss in the later and upcoming raids.

Alternatively a safer bet is taking inspiration from the druid and reducing the chance to be crit and give a % bonus to stam, or dmg reduction.

You could aim to make them able to perhaps even more reliably keep crits and crushes off the attack table through avoidance than warriors can through giving both holy shield and redoubt reliable uptime, but it seems a bit infringing on the warrior deal to me

author: Taishu
subject: 一位狂热的中国圣骑士关于天赋和技能的修改建议
content_md:
由于我对圣骑士职业的热爱，不得不提出我的一些建议，希望乌龟魔兽可以采纳。很遗憾，我的英语水平不行，只能用中文来阐述我的建议了。
圣骑士这个混合职业拥有不俗的治疗技能，原官方的开发者为了平衡就严重削弱了圣骑士的坦克能力和输出能力
显然这对防御骑士和惩戒骑士是不公平的，所以我提出以下修改建议，希望乌龟服的开发者可以作为参考。
针对60级版本的圣骑作如下调整：
 1、神圣之力天赋天赋改为强化智慧祝福，5点满后效果提升为15%
 2、强化正义圣印天赋改为神圣指引，效果为从智力获取法术伤害，换算比例为智力总值的20%
 3、圣洁光环天赋改为王者祝福。
 4、强化智慧祝福天赋改为强化光明祝福，2点满效果提升20%。
 5、神恩术改为训练师学习，原天赋位置改为圣光闪现
 6、圣光闪现改为天赋技能
 7、圣光术改为神圣天赋的终极天赋学习，而不是在训练师那里学习。
 8、神圣震击改为训练师学习，冷却时间改为20秒。
 9、强化虔诚光环改为强化光环，提升光环效果20%
 10、精准和强化保护祝福这两个天赋与惩戒系的强化力量祝福对调，
 11、强化力量祝福改为神圣之力，点满后效果改为提升15%的力量值。
 12、强化正义之怒与强化制裁之锤对调位置
 13、强化公正圣印的天赋名称改为正义捍卫者，取消原天赋效果，点满后效果改为：圣骑士受到的法术伤害减少15%。
 14、清算天赋取消，改为圣骑士遭受暴击后，产生一个护盾，5点满吸收圣骑士最大生命值的20%的伤害，每分钟仅出现一次，护盾持续10秒。
 15、单手武器专精改为炽热防御者，点满5点后，效果与原效果不变
 16、防护系的最终天赋炽热防御者改为神圣盾击，基础伤害为主手武器伤害50%的神圣伤害，受攻击强度加成，并强迫目标攻击自己，造成大量仇恨，受攻击强度加成，冷却时间为6秒。
 17、祈福天赋改成定罪，点满后增加5%致命一击几率
 18、强化审判天赋除原有效果以外，2点加满后每次审判将恢复圣骑士人物的20%的基础法力值（并非圣印消耗的基础法力值），同时会产生一个小队buff，小队成员将有100%的几率每5秒获得1%的法力值上限的法力。
 18.1，审判法术判定为物理远程攻击，受攻击强度加成，伤害属性为神圣伤害，命中属性为物理命中，审判的作用距离增加10码。
 19、十字军之心天赋点满后的效果为：在圣骑士造成致命一击后，有30%的几率攻击速度加快20%，持续10秒。
 20、原王者祝福改为圣洁光环（被动天赋技能），效果为圣骑士的神圣伤害提高10%，且让圣骑士及其队友在任何光环作用下的所有伤害提升3%
 21、辩护天赋的效果改成点满后降低目标的攻击速度20%，持续15秒。
 22、定罪天赋效果改为：增加圣骑士的审判法术和圣印法术伤害的致命一击几率15%
 23、取消强化惩罚光环天赋，天赋名称改为圣洁光环：每点使圣骑士在任何光环影响下的攻击速度提升3%
 24、取消命令圣印天赋，命令圣印天赋改为十字军打击，冷却时间为4.5秒，造成100%武器伤害，十字军打击将对目标造成圣光灼烧debuff，总共堆叠三层，每层伤害为武器平均伤害的20%，debuff存在时间为10秒，十字军打击和debuff的伤害受攻击强度加成。
 25、双手武器专精天赋改为武器专精，天赋点数由3点增加到5点，点满后提升双手武器伤害10%
 26、复仇天赋改为堆叠3层，需要的天赋点数从5点减到3点，其他效果不变。
 27、忏悔天赋改为神圣打击，神圣打击为瞬发法术（而不是现在的下一次武器攻击），冷却时间10秒，命中属性为物理命中，对目标造成110%武器伤害的神圣伤害，有30%几率触发武器特效（包括附魔特效），同时削弱目标的伤害20%，持续5秒。
 28、忏悔改为训练师学习，效果持续：非玩家瘫痪30秒，玩家为瘫痪10秒，冷却时间改为30秒，可以对所有目标生效。
 29、命令圣印和正义圣印合并，名称保留为正义圣印，触发效果为每次命中100%触发，造成武器伤害50%的神圣伤害，命中属性为物理命中，能被所有攻击触发，且能产生暴击，受攻击强度加成。圣印的基础审判伤害为原命令圣印在目标昏迷状态下的审判伤害，正义圣印的持续时间为30分钟，审判不再消耗圣印，审判受攻击强度加成。
 30、取消十字军圣印，智慧圣印、光明圣印、公正圣印不再是圣印技能，改为武器祝福，其中公正武器祝福效果改为有一定几率使目标无法移动，持续3秒。每次只能允许一种武器祝福存在，武器祝福的持续时间为30分钟，智慧印记和光明印记的效果维持原圣印效果不变。在武器祝福的影响下，圣骑士的审判法术，将造成原有圣印法术带来的审判效果。
 31、驱邪术可对所有目标生效，对亡灵则造成100%暴击，受法伤加成。
 32、神圣愤怒改为瞬发技能，无冷却时间，作用范围、法力值和伤害不变，可对所有目标生效，受法伤加成，但释放技能后自身会损失当前人物最大生命值的10%
 33、奉献的效果改为将神圣之力灌注到圣骑士周围半径10码范围内的所有目标体内，产生灼烧伤害，持续8秒，奉献效果持续期间，目标的移动速度减缓60%，奉献冷却时间为20秒。
 34、制裁之锤除造成昏迷效果外，还将造成目标沉默3秒的效果，并造成50%的武器伤害。

最后希望圣骑士每个天赋需要的装备得到重新设计，包括圣契之类的玩意儿。

显然这对防御骑士和惩戒骑士是不公平的，所以我提出以下修改建议，希望乌龟服的开发者可以作为参考。
针对60级版本的圣骑作如下调整：
1、神圣之力天赋天赋改为强化智慧祝福，5点满后效果提升为15%
2、强化正义圣印天赋改为神圣指引，效果为从智力获取法术伤害，换算比例为智力总值的20%
3、圣洁光环天赋改为王者祝福。
4、强化智慧祝福天赋改为强化光明祝福，2点满效果提升20%。
5、神恩术改为训练师学习，原天赋位置改为圣光闪现
6、圣光闪现改为天赋技能
7、圣光术改为神圣天赋的终极天赋学习，而不是在训练师那里学习。
8、神圣震击改为训练师学习，冷却时间改为20秒。
9、强化虔诚光环改为强化光环，提升光环效果20%
10、精准和强化保护祝福这两个天赋与惩戒系的强化力量祝福对调，
11、强化力量祝福改为神圣之力，点满后效果改为提升15%的力量值。
12、强化正义之怒与强化制裁之锤对调位置
13、强化公正圣印的天赋名称改为正义捍卫者，取消原天赋效果，点满后效果改为：圣骑士受到的法术伤害减少15%。
14、清算天赋取消，改为圣骑士遭受暴击后，产生一个护盾，5点满吸收圣骑士最大生命值的20%的伤害，每分钟仅出现一次，护盾持续10秒。
15、单手武器专精改为炽热防御者，点满5点后，效果与原效果不变
16、防护系的最终天赋炽热防御者改为神圣盾击，基础伤害为主手武器伤害50%的神圣伤害，受攻击强度加成，并强迫目标攻击自己，造成大量仇恨，受攻击强度加成，冷却时间为6秒。
17、祈福天赋改成定罪，点满后增加5%致命一击几率
18、强化审判天赋除原有效果以外，2点加满后每次审判将恢复圣骑士人物的20%的基础法力值（并非圣印消耗的基础法力值），同时会产生一个小队buff，小队成员将有100%的几率每5秒获得1%的法力值上限的法力。
18.1，审判法术判定为物理远程攻击，受攻击强度加成，伤害属性为神圣伤害，命中属性为物理命中，审判的作用距离增加10码。
19、十字军之心天赋点满后的效果为：在圣骑士造成致命一击后，有30%的几率攻击速度加快20%，持续10秒。
20、原王者祝福改为圣洁光环（被动天赋技能），效果为圣骑士的神圣伤害提高10%，且让圣骑士及其队友在任何光环作用下的所有伤害提升3%
21、辩护天赋的效果改成点满后降低目标的攻击速度20%，持续15秒。
22、定罪天赋效果改为：增加圣骑士的审判法术和圣印法术伤害的致命一击几率15%
23、取消强化惩罚光环天赋，天赋名称改为圣洁光环：每点使圣骑士在任何光环影响下的攻击速度提升3%
24、取消命令圣印天赋，命令圣印天赋改为十字军打击，冷却时间为4.5秒，造成100%武器伤害，十字军打击将对目标造成圣光灼烧debuff，总共堆叠三层，每层伤害为武器平均伤害的20%，debuff存在时间为10秒，十字军打击和debuff的伤害受攻击强度加成。
25、双手武器专精天赋改为武器专精，天赋点数由3点增加到5点，点满后提升双手武器伤害10%
26、复仇天赋改为堆叠3层，需要的天赋点数从5点减到3点，其他效果不变。
27、忏悔天赋改为神圣打击，神圣打击为瞬发法术（而不是现在的下一次武器攻击），冷却时间10秒，命中属性为物理命中，对目标造成110%武器伤害的神圣伤害，有30%几率触发武器特效（包括附魔特效），同时削弱目标的伤害20%，持续5秒。
28、忏悔改为训练师学习，效果持续：非玩家瘫痪30秒，玩家为瘫痪10秒，冷却时间改为30秒，可以对所有目标生效。
29、命令圣印和正义圣印合并，名称保留为正义圣印，触发效果为每次命中100%触发，造成武器伤害50%的神圣伤害，命中属性为物理命中，能被所有攻击触发，且能产生暴击，受攻击强度加成。圣印的基础审判伤害为原命令圣印在目标昏迷状态下的审判伤害，正义圣印的持续时间为30分钟，审判不再消耗圣印，审判受攻击强度加成。
30、取消十字军圣印，智慧圣印、光明圣印、公正圣印不再是圣印技能，改为武器祝福，其中公正武器祝福效果改为有一定几率使目标无法移动，持续3秒。每次只能允许一种武器祝福存在，武器祝福的持续时间为30分钟，智慧印记和光明印记的效果维持原圣印效果不变。在武器祝福的影响下，圣骑士的审判法术，将造成原有圣印法术带来的审判效果。
31、驱邪术可对所有目标生效，对亡灵则造成100%暴击，受法伤加成。
32、神圣愤怒改为瞬发技能，无冷却时间，作用范围、法力值和伤害不变，可对所有目标生效，受法伤加成，但释放技能后自身会损失当前人物最大生命值的10%
33、奉献的效果改为将神圣之力灌注到圣骑士周围半径10码范围内的所有目标体内，产生灼烧伤害，持续8秒，奉献效果持续期间，目标的移动速度减缓60%，奉献冷却时间为20秒。
34、制裁之锤除造成昏迷效果外，还将造成目标沉默3秒的效果，并造成50%的武器伤害。

最后希望圣骑士每个天赋需要的装备得到重新设计，包括圣契之类的玩意儿。

subject: Paladin Seals Rework
content_md:
1-Seal of Command

Every time Paladin hit target deal additional Holy damage equal to 50% of normal weapon damage.  Only one seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time.  Lasts 30 sec.

that mean Seal of command will deal damage in hit not in chance like older V,  making the seal less frustrating and random to play with.

 2-Seal of the Crusader

Fills the Paladin with the spirit of a crusader for 30 sec, granting 326 melee attack power. The Paladin also attacks 30% faster, Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time.

Unleashing this Seal's energy will judge an enemy for 10 sec, increasing the melee attack speed on target by 10% by any attacker.  Your melee strikes will refresh the spell's duration.  Only one Judgement per Paladin can be active at any one time.

most paladin only use Seal of Command or Seal of Righteousness to deal damage Ignoring Seal of the Crusader because the backoff that come with it " less damage 5% every time you hit target" making use the seal more annoying to use compare to other seals,  that why i change the seal to 30% more faster attack speed with granting 326 melee attack power, in intention to make paladin do less damage then fury warrior and rouge.

in my opinion i think Seal of the Crusader should be valuable way to deal damage next to SoC and SoR

Seal of Righteousness scale with SP for spellpower builds
Seal of the Crusader scale with AP and attack speed for pure physical builds
Seal of Command scale in both since it's 20 point seal

i think Judgement of Crusader will be more fitting this way, not only helping the paladin to do more damage but also his team mates.

Fills the Paladin with divine wisdom for 30 sec, each melee attack will restore mana equal to Paladin's spirit,  Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time.

(1 spirit stat = 1 mana generation ) so if you have like 78 spirit stat you will generate like 78 mana

i think seal of wisdom need rework to make it worth use it more then it's own judgement or other seals

Fills the Paladin with divine light for 30 sec, each melee attack will heal the Paladin equal to his spirit, Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time.

(1 spirit stat = 1 heath generation )

just like Seal of Wisdom but instead of mana, it will generate heath based on spirit

author: Jrobz
subject: Re: Paladin Seals Rework
content_md:
Plausible idea for SotC:

Keep JoW/JoL the same as now. Revert JotC back to the original version and remove Crusader Strike. Slight buff to the Holy DMG bonus of JotC if need be. Have the Paladin's SoW/SoL effect the whole group aka heal/mana the group when it procs.

Reduce the DMG reduction of SotC by a little, not a ton, boosting it slightly. Add to it, a 100% chance to proc JoW/JoL and increase the chance to proc Weapon effects. Make SotC the semi-passive regen/utility Seal it was always meant to be.

Plausible idea for Crusader Strike:

TBC version. Ret End Talent. Gains physical DMG bonus from +holy so it all works together. Replaces HolyStrike. Move Rep a level up. I know there considerable QQ about Ret in PvP right now. I don't see this making that go away at all. What it will do it balance out the physical and holy dmg, give their rotation a better feel, and bring SoC back into a more usable state.

Edit: Like I've said in other threads, TWoW likely needs to fix Prot first. Since so many go deep Ret to tank, messing with Ret will impact current PvE tanking meta. We likely want to fix the broken meta and then repair Ret.

author: Jrobz
subject: Re: Paladin Seals Rework
content_md:
To the OPs point, you more or less never use seals besides SoR (even when trying to regen mana/health). The Judges are switched up, which more or less means the Judges are ok but the Seals are all unfinished. Having SoW/SoL proc for the group really hammers home the Group Support role for Ret and maybe even gives Holy a reason to be wearing plate.. Having the TBC Crusader strike refreshing the Judgements on the Boss brings another element of synergy among Group/Raid Paladins and keeps Ret's raid utility high.

Reworking SotC (solo mana/health regen and weapon procs) and JotC (group/raid holy dmg bonus) give those a very designated and purposeful space and removes the awkward and spammy TWoW Crusader Strike implementation. Remember one thing the original JotC does is allow Priests to flex to some DPS if healing is not needed. IMO there is a HUGE reason Smite and SotC have the same icon.

I know some dont like it but I dont mind the taunt on JoJ. SoJ could have a chance to interrupt if the current stun based implementation is simply non-functional,and the IMP talents in Prot could increase the chance along with add taunt on JoJ.

content_html:
To the OPs point, you more or less never use seals besides SoR (even when trying to regen mana/health). The Judges are switched up, which more or less means the Judges are ok but the Seals are all unfinished. Having SoW/SoL proc for the group really hammers home the Group Support role for Ret and maybe even gives Holy a reason to be wearing plate.. Having the TBC Crusader strike refreshing the Judgements on the Boss brings another element of synergy among Group/Raid Paladins and keeps Ret's raid utility high.

Reworking SotC (solo mana/health regen and weapon procs) and JotC (group/raid holy dmg bonus) give those a very designated and purposeful space and removes the awkward and spammy TWoW Crusader Strike implementation. Remember one thing the original JotC does is allow Priests to flex to some DPS if healing is not needed. IMO there is a HUGE reason Smite and SotC have the same icon.

I know some dont like it but I dont mind the taunt on JoJ. SoJ could have a chance to interrupt if the current stun based implementation is simply non-functional,and the IMP talents in Prot could increase the chance along with add taunt on JoJ.

Seal/Judge is a VERY unique element to the Vanilla Paladin and really each should have a use and it would be ideal if every paladin, Skirtadin or not, used them. They should be the Alliance 'totems'.

author: Redmagejoe
subject: Re: TAUNT WHEN?
content_md:
> **Aljava wrote: Sat Sep 30, 2023 9:04 am**
> folks start looking to other classes' abilities and try to have everything fair, yes that's when I'll say the game is ruined because kit design became symmetrically boring and class identity goes out of the window. I did subscribed to the idea that it was such an oversight to not grant paladin's access to a taunt, now we have it yet still not enough, it has to be the absolute same. Heck seeing this, I'd want druid's growl to be reworked, it's just too similar to warriors'!

This is such gross misattribution of game mechanics. "Taunt" is not an invention of World of Warcraft, of Warriors, or of Bear Druids. This is an ability as ancient as tabletop RPGs and exists for an express purpose to fulfill an explicit need in mechanical systems that design enemies with an "I don't fucking care how good you've been playing, fuck your healer now" mechanic, which World of Warcraft absolutely has. You clearly have never played Paladin as a tank for an extended period of time if you think their current, piss-poor implementation of Taunt is "good enough".

For starters, the baseline taunt from Wrath onward has ALREADY been ported and just put behind some incredibly questionable mechanics, so this starts your argument on shaky grounds. Other than the fact that you have to put 3 talent points at levels 25, 26, and 27 into an otherwise terrible talent that affects a terrible Seal, actually executing your Taunt is worse than shifting out of Bear Form or switching stances and dumping all of your Rage, because at least in those scenarios you can get Rage back. Prot Paladin, if you didn't know, relies on very finite amounts of mana (as they aren't stacking copious amounts of Intellect) and very costly spells (not even talking about Consecrate) to generate threat outside of reactive threat and sustain their mana. This comes in the form of Judgement of Wisdom and Seal of Righteousness, both locked behind an 8-10 second cooldown Judgement, which also costs mana.

Imagine if you will, that you are operating at roughly 1000 mana or less in the middle of a pull.  This happens QUITE frequently given the nature of the build, as I have described before.  God help you if you are fighting things you cannot block to regenerate mana, such as casters or Elementals. All of a sudden, you need to taunt. Now you need to spend 170 mana on a seal no one wants to use, spend 75+ mana on a Judgement you don't want to use, and then you need to spend another 215 on Holy Strike and 170 on Seal of Righteousness to try to HOLD that aggro and build up threat again which just got dumped.

Consider that in 8-10 seconds, you are either not regenerating mana or generating threat as you must choose between Seal of Wisdom or Righteousness, so you also need to be ready to spend another 170 mana to get Seal of Wisdom back on, so that you can judge that, then put Seal of Righteousness back on, and hope that the threat dump mechanic hasn't happened again in that time.

What you end up with is a tank tapped out of mana incapable of generating further threat unless the enemy is glued to you and triggering blocks, which relies on, you guessed it, having aggro. All of this because having a baseline taunt is "too similar". Consider this perspective: Warrior and Bear don't have Taunt because it was designed explicitly around their class identity, they have Taunt because Taunt, in a vacuum, is a necessary part of a tank's toolkit.

tl;dr If your class doesn't have a baseline taunt in the context of World of Warcraft NPC combat mechanics, your class is not an actual tank and the design team should not attempt to lean into it being a tank. Prot Paladin's current taunt implementation cannot work unless the Paladin has more ways to regenerate mana than having the enemy's attention at all times.

author: Manletow
subject: Re: nerf paladins dps alredy
content_md:
The average Blood Ring experience (for Horde) is the following:

Ret paladin charges straight at you (probably the healer) on their 108% speed mount into

Holy Shock crit 1k, (into 6 sec stun HoJ), Holy Strike Crit 2k, Seal of Command Crit 1k = total 4k dmg

The average decent geared 60 player has around 3000-4000 hp.
 90% of players are already dead within roughly 6 seconds.

(If they are cheeky they can overkill with Goblin Sapper charge for another 750 dmg)

The 108% speed mount is what really screws casters over because if the ret had to 'jog' at you at least Horde casters would have time to slow them down or blow them up.

And melee classes obviously don't have a choice but to try and laughably face tank this massive Holy damage onslaught. Good luck with that.

And of course if by some MIRACLE you survive this initial atom bomb of damage... they can very likely simply outlast you with their excessive toolkit of survival abilities + heavy armor + high health.

This new patch will mildly nerf Divine Shield and make Blood Ring 3v3 so **maybe** matches will be slightly less heavily biased in Alliance favor. :S

The average game opens with "triple to quadruple crits" right.. no it doesn't. Not even close. The mind is geared to remember bad events rather than normal or good events. Can this happen (assuming you meant JoC vs Holy Shock but that is giving this QQ more legs than it's likely worth), sure. Is this at all likely? No. No it isn't. It would NOT be absurd to say a higher end geared Warrior would average near 2.5-3k on the opening barrage on a squishier target. If he does get a white crit, and got the charge off, he can can likely fit in a WW (at GCD 2 or 3), pushing this to 3-3.5k+ in the first few seconds. Scale these back on less squishy targets.

Oh right, when I say Spelladin, I mean more a T2.5/PvP geared Ret, as opposed to physical Retadin. I mean Plate, AP, SP, and crit. I don't mean the cloth gang.

I think that is much of the issue we'll face with non-Holy Spec Paladins on TWoW. MANY will see the TBC Paladin patch as having FINALLY finished the class. This mindset will clash with Vanilla purests or those that want as little changed as possible. IMO Paladin is the least finished class in Vanilla. There are certainly specs that need work on several classes (Arcane Mage, Survival Hunter, etc), but Paladin is the only one I see that requires SIGNIFICANT work on 2 out of 3 specs. I do think we shouldn't be too shy about incorporating many TBC isms when it comes to class reworks. author: Atreidon
subject: Re: nerf paladins dps alredy
content_md:
A lot of people arent frustrated with paladins dps. The dps of paladin is not particularly threatening without windfury. But like all classes with a twohander, his burst potential is very threatening.
The custom holy strike ability has made the burst of paladins much more consistent.

But the main problem is not the ability itself. It is holy strike (and seal of command) applying % based dmg bonuses like berserking & vengeance twice.

Particularly berserking ends up being a +69% dmg increase on holy strike. Without this bug turned feature, paladins even with exceptional gear struggle to burst people down. And once their burst combo is over, if their target is still alive they struggle to finish it off while they are succeptable to CC or letting their target heal themselves.

I do agree that paladin is too threatening, but what makes him obnoxious is this double dipping bug for the burst and the lifestealing jotc abuse. Not baseline access to holy strike

>
>  I do agree that paladin is too threatening, but what makes him obnoxious is this double dipping bug for the burst and the lifestealing jotc abuse. Not baseline access to holy strike

They just need to change seal of casino to flat 35% weapon dmg on all attack & judgment doing 70% weapon dmg

as for holy strike it should become weapon dmg base something like X% weapon dmg as holy dmg & restore XX% mana and an additional 2%/4%/6%/8%/10% over X sec for the paladin & X party/raid members for each stack of Crusader Strike.

Dmg increase for Holy Strike should be under 2h Mastery talent, so it requires that to do more dmg with holy strike.

This way Holy Strike wont hit like a truck often & when it does, it doesn't one shot people when the pally wins the slot machine. It also fix some of ret's issue when it comes to mana.

The dev need to get away from their philosophy behind ret paladin, unless they make it so tier set function like GW2 gear where you can choose stat types & have one like celestial or give add into 1 of the ret talent that ret gets SP from Agil so paladin can just wear shammy & hunter gears then it wont work the way they want.
content_html:
A lot of people arent frustrated with paladins dps. The dps of paladin is not particularly threatening without windfury. But like all classes with a twohander, his burst potential is very threatening.
The custom holy strike ability has made the burst of paladins much more consistent.

But the main problem is not the ability itself. It is holy strike (and seal of command) applying % based dmg bonuses like berserking & vengeance twice.

Particularly berserking ends up being a +69% dmg increase on holy strike. Without this bug turned feature, paladins even with exceptional gear struggle to burst people down. And once their burst combo is over, if their target is still alive they struggle to finish it off while they are succeptable to CC or letting their target heal themselves.

I do agree that paladin is too threatening, but what makes him obnoxious is this double dipping bug for the burst and the lifestealing jotc abuse. Not baseline access to holy strike

They just need to change seal of casino to flat 35% weapon dmg on all attack & judgment doing 70% weapon dmg

as for holy strike it should become weapon dmg base something like X% weapon dmg as holy dmg & restore XX% mana and an additional 2%/4%/6%/8%/10% over X sec for the paladin & X party/raid members for each stack of Crusader Strike.

Dmg increase for Holy Strike should be under 2h Mastery talent, so it requires that to do more dmg with holy strike.

This way Holy Strike wont hit like a truck often & when it does, it doesn't one shot people when the pally wins the slot machine. It also fix some of ret's issue when it comes to mana.

The dev need to get away from their philosophy behind ret paladin, unless they make it so tier set function like GW2 gear where you can choose stat types & have one like celestial or give add into 1 of the ret talent that ret gets SP from Agil so paladin can just wear shammy & hunter gears then it wont work the way they want.

author: Akos1896
subject: Re: nerf paladins dps alredy
content_md:
Palas indeed have 1 overtuned ability. I don't think that the whole class is broken, it is not. They are a below average power-level class with 1 weapon of mass destruction attached to them.
I doubt that TWOW every fixes how holy damage works in the game and because of that offensive holy spells should always be very limited. I want to see holy strike being changed to a mostly melee ability. Once done and the 'weapon of mass destruction' got removed, paladins could actually be buffed.
Current duality about how people regard paladins comes from this:
Overall pala is a support class and it is not outstanding at maintained damage dealing. Even after buffs, serious guilds don't bring DPS pala. Pala players know about these limitations (and others which the paladins have) and outrage when someone says nerf pala.
PVP players playing against pala see a plate guy in a bubble, who can barely be scratched, spamming huge damages which bypass armor and can't be resisted (again, the nature of holy magic in the game).
I think both sides have some truth. Paladin has (at least) 1 way overtuned ability which has to be nerfed but after that paladin DPS as a whole has to be buffed (not abusing holy damage though).

subject: Re: nerf paladins dps alredy
content_md:
People who think paladins were bad at pvp in vanilla are just flat out wrong

there's two and a half classes who could get an edge on you, spriest, some locks, and some fire mages. and you could still beat them if you played LoS, fake casted, and used all your abilities correctly. Even shamans if you could outplay their burst would just oom and let you beat them softly with your mace until dead. everyone else you would simply outlast, or be able to burst when they stopped paying attention

and that's just dueling

yes mages have shields, and rogues have evasion, etc. The difference is paladin can cast BoP or freedom on others, which makes it more valuable than these other classes defensive options. druids must shift for utility, priests cant use holy spells in shadow form, and shamans will oom in 2 seconds trying to both heal and burst. Paladin's on turtle can wear full spellpower gear, boosting their heals, and still smack you for 1.5x the damage of a lightning bolt at half the cost. They lose very little damage comparitively by being full holy spec rather than ret

my favorite line that paladins on turtle use is "the warrior class dev nerfed paladins in wow development because he lost to a paladin in a duel". Tell me, in OG vanilla with no turtle changes, how often are warriors beating paladins in duels? if paladins were nerfed because they beat warriors, youd think warrior wouldnt be their easiest matchup still

author: Partyboyza
subject: Protection Paladin Simple Talent Improvements V1.02
content_md:
Hi everyone, I play as protection paladin (Belriose) I will present a simple vanilla like protection paladin talent rework.
The protection spec should mostly use deep protection based skills and talents as it's intended.

I will try to offer some of my opinions on how to improve the build without breaking the game or the raiding tank meta: Warrior->Druid->Paladin
I will highlight the areas where the protection paladin talent tree is lacking in proficiency:

 **1. Damage mitigation**
 **2. Mana regen**
 **3. Small health pool**
 **5. Viable, cheap and simple to use taunt**
 **6. Range pull**

The protection paladin should have around 9% damage reduction from all sources, as to increase the survivability and mana burden on healers and this is how I suggest we go around this:

 1. **Improved Blessing of Sanctuary** (new row 20 talent, prerequisite Blessing of Sanctuary) 1 talent point:
 1 point, a new spell with 10min cooldown that can stack with blessing of sanctuary, increase dmg reduction by 3%
No explanation needed, simple to implement, it also has benefits in raids.

 2. **Improved Righteous Fury**, 3 talent points: add 1% damage reduction from all sources for each level

 3. **Seal of the Defender** (new row 30 talent)  Holy Shield as prerequisite, move ardent defender to the right in the talent tree.
Fills the paladin with holy spirit dealing  2x 30 extra holy damage attacks on weapon swing roughly same amount of holy damage as Seal of Righteousness after each hit:
 -while the seal is active, reduce all damage taken by 3%;
Judging the seal will cause same amount of holy damage as Seal Righteousness.
Judging the seal will add 2 holy shield charges. (to help with Reckoning, see below)
We need extra attacks to avoid using non tanking items that have +2 extra dmg to proc judgement of wisdom.
This solves that issue, and also helps the prot paladin land more weapon procs for extra threat.
With this change the mana problems will completely disappear.

 4. **One Handed Weapon specialization** same place in tree, 5 point talent, and each talent point increases all damage by 1% / 2% / 3% /4%/ 5% and stamina by 1% / 2% / 3% /4%/ 5% while one handed weapon is equipped and a downside, decreases all damage done while two handed weapons are equipped by 2% /4% / 6% / 8% / 10%.

 5. **Reckoning**, 5 point talent, 10%/20%/30%/40%/50% chance on block to add an extra weapon attack, on your next weapon swing.

 6. **Viable, cheap and simple to use taunt** (row 25 talent) (5 talent points)
 **Ardent Defender** : (1 point row 30) Change passive from When you have less than 35% health->50% health, damage is reduced by 25% -> 2%/ 4%/ 6%/ 8% / 10%, and now can be activated to taunt for 3 seconds 3yd range 10 sec cooldown.
No protection paladin in their right mind would miss this after this change.

 7. **Improved Devotion Aura** remains 5 point talent, but now it also increases defense skill by 1 per talent point.

 8. **Toughness** all around good talent point, should stay the same

 9. **Anticipation** somewhat weak, but it gives the prot paladin an opportunity to get some defense.

 **10. Improved Hammer of Wrath** (5 talents)
Reduces cast time by 0.2 /0.4 / 0.5 / 0.6 / 0.8 / 1 second,
only usable at enemies that have less than 36% / 52%/ 68% / 84% / 100% life,
and reduces damage by 15% / 30% / 45% / 60% / 75%,
and increases cooldown to 10 / 15 / 20 / 25 / 30 seconds.
And reduce mana cost by 15% / 30% / 45% / 60% / 75%.
Basically our hammer of wrath will become our main range pull with:
Instant cast (to be used while tanking as well) damage reduced by 75%, and a cooldown of 30 seconds (as to not be spammed and mostly used when pulling packs every 30 seconds), and used when the enemy has 100% life.

 11. Everything else should stay the same.

 12. Remove **Improved Seal of Justice**

In conclusion this build we will get:

+9% damage reduction out of which 3% can be redirected towards someone else.
+5% increased all damage
+5% extra stamina
+15 defense skill
+4 holy shield charges from judging **Seal of the Defender**
+50% chance for extra swing on block, on your next melee attack
+2 extra holy damage attacks to proc judgement of wisdom and replace non tanking items with +2 fire damage
+1 on demand low cost taunt
+1 range pull 30yd range, instant cast, reduced damage by 75%

I hope you liked it, this has a very vanilla/tbc flavor to it, and I think it will fit perfectly for Turtle Wow and it's great community.
I'm open for any suggestions. And I will continue to update the build.
If the devs need help implementing this build or altering I will gladly help.

Rank7: Imp Judgement - Range increased to 30y
Rank6 (1/1) (inline with HS and Imp Judge): Imp HolyShield - reset Consecration on proc, add 2 procs, increased dmg
Rank6: One Hand Spec: 2/4/6/8/10% to all DMG and threat while Shield is equipped
Rank5: Move AD here
Rank5: Reckoning (3/3 instead of 5/5): Reset HolyStrike CD on parry/dodge/miss (33/66/100%) - only procs when wearing a shield
Rank3: Anticipation: Gain 10/20/30% of INT as SBV

content_md:
Dont to mean to spam ideas here, but another for your SotD:

Tie the proc damage to some form of scalable melee element (like say 40 or 50% normal weapon dmg) to make use of STR/AP and later end weapons. This will also remove the Flurry Axe meta (which is healthy for the spec). Also rather than being a SoR double doink, just up the proc rate of JoW/JoL when SotD is active. That would also be a VERY valid end talent.. IMO the prot paladin has no issues in solo PvE play. Too much mana regen could make it the "leveling spec" if it isnt already.

subject: Re: The State of Paladin Tier sets and itemization for PVE RET
content_md:
Seal of the Crusader is definitely terrible and I've made my own thoughts on it quite known: [viewtopic.php?f=41&t=4177](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?f=41&t=4177)

However, using TBC/Wrath as a comparison to vanilla design philosophies is a mistake. There are a plethora of options that can be taken without dipping toes into the ideas that furthered WoW's decline. That is why we play a vanilla style server is it not?

I think the biggest issue here is having a clear design intent for paladin. Vanilla leaves paladins pretty lacking in direction, especially after patch 1.9, as the game wasn't built with their overhauled design in mind. Hell, the spell coefficients weren't even adjusted to be decent when the base damage is terrible. And personally I think the existence of holy strike hamstrings further changes to the class. It really is too much. Same for CS.

Want paladins to fulfill the fantasy of being anti-undead instead of being lackluster at is supposed to be their thing? Remove the cooldown on turn undead. Halve the cost and reduce the cooldown of exorcism to 5 seconds. Halve the cost and reduce the cooldown of holy wrath to 8-10 seconds. It literally affects nothing but PvE content and its not even in an overpowered way.

Want stock paladin to perform better in pve with minimal pvp impact? Halve the mana cost of HoW and allow it to not to reset the swing timer. Allow JoC to do double damage against naturally stun immune creatures. These are just examples and there is a lot more that could be done to minimally change the fundamental design while also minimally impacting the game without borrowing from the expansions.

author: Geojak
subject: Paladin classchanges 2.0
content_md:
Tackling pala balance is not that easy but doable. You need to lock at many things, especially burst in pvp and wf totem and procc synergy in pve.

A. Holy Strike and Seal Of Command double dip formula removed
SoC double dipping is blizzlike, the formula has always been
((70% weapon_dmg ) + spellpower bonus dmg ) *1.15, but the weapon dmg itlsef is already incrase by 15%, therefor benefitting twice from dmg multipliers on attackpower.
But this has become an issue with the addition of holy strike. The weapon_dmg in the fomula needs to be adjusted to be without dmg multipliers. This will be a MASSIVE nerf to paladin burst in pvp and, and full physical ret paladin dmg in pve and should not be done in a vacuum.

B. Soc rank 1 shouldnt be used over max rank. currently all seals give 70% adn only differcne is the judgement base dmg. We can increase the %dmg per rank slighly, rank 1 65%, rank 2 70%, rank 3 75%, rank 4 80%, rank 5 85%.

C. SoR changes
SoR is very good, especially with wf. We need to buff pala dps indepedant of wf and nerf how well we scale with proccs in general to be less lame
 1. SoR talent bug fixed that the 3/6/9/13/15% dmg increase is not just baseline but also sp part
 2. SoR does not double procc anymore. (still 2 jow proccs thought because every dmg source counts)

D. Crusuader strike changes:
Spamming crusader strikes for pvp pushback and proccs like frostoil and in pve to fish for wf proccs is carrying paladins. we are overreliant on it and i dont consdier hamstring fishing on warrior fun either. spammin on veery gcd needs to go
 1. Give crusader strike 4.5s cd
 2. Change the dmg to holy
 3. Give it small scaling like Soc, thaz means 19% from holy spellpower 11% from normal sp.
 4. allow crusader strike to crit (meele crit chance)
 5. increase the mana cost by 30%

E. Help ret paladins always threat capped
unlike berserker stance or rogues inherent passive or all range classes, paladins have no way to reduce  the threat they cause. this makes them always threat capped first. we could help a litte here
Add to the 2h weapon talent the additional affect, reduce all threat caues by 5/10/15% when righeouness furry is not active. this is the same value warrios enjoy from beserker stance

Tdlr A-E.
Less burst from Soc and holy strike prevent 3k+ mega burst
Less procc and wf dependant gameplay
More SoC and SoR dmg
Less threat for ret paladains, same as for warriors

Lets focus on protection paladins

F. Holy Shield changes
Change holy shield definiton form spell to ability, so that you can use it while being silenced just like holy strike already is and Warriors shield block is too. this will make tanking for paladins fairer. Note that warr sheild block is also of GCD while paladin holy shield requirres a GCD. that could be changed too

G. Vindication is bugged and does not work currently in pve
This talent reduces the targets strenght and agiltty when procced. the problem is, on cmangos npcs do not have strength or agllity unlike in classic where they do have it. he reuslt is the talent only works in pvp in twow but its not even worth using there.
 --> Make it reduce the targets attackpower instead since npcs do have attackpower. 1 attack power per level and talent points, so at lvl 60 it would reduce the targets attackpower by 60/120/180 with 3 talent points.

H. New active abbility Argent defender 31 prot talent,
 12 second CD active ability: strike your target with your shield dealing X base dmg + 200% block value + 33% sp as holy dmg. triggers redoubt on use.
This allows to keep redoubt up more reliable and with holy shield you can become crush immune, jsut like warriors allways could reliably with their 75% shield block. It also gives paladins anotheer holy trheat ability with sheild to make up for the above nerfs. currenly all prot palas are acutally ret talented isntead

I. Anticicaption talent made usefull, changed to reduced dmg by 1/2/3/4/5%
currently it gives 2/4/6/8/10 defesen with 5 points. its a total noob trap. it scales horribly into endgame too, noobody uses it in raids unless for very special cases to get crit immune.
New effect is to make up for paladins not having defesnive stance which reduces dmg by 10%. now its an intersting option for raid tanks to take instead of the shield specc talent that gives mana on the same line.

TLDR: F-I
Holy Shield made less punishing against silence
Vindication bug fixed (talent does not work currently)
Argent defnder turned into pala shield slam that also allows palads to become crush capped like warriors
Mini Defensive Stance added by changing tweaking useless anticipation talent

Bonus Suggestions:

J. Exocism
make it usable against all targets, half damage against non undead non demon.
Everytime I step into stratholme I feel like, this is it. This is how paladins should be. With a range Pull and extra holy dmg threat.

K. Seal of Crusader and Judgement of Crusader force procc nonsense rework
This seal has sooo many issues and the current force procc judgement effect that was custom twow added must die.
 1. remove the dmg reductiton from the seal
 2. change the judgmenet to casue an instant physical strike dealing weapon dmg + X bonus dmg dependant on rank to your target +1 other. like a mini whillwind. atleast the seal would have a niche in cleave sitatuions like this for full physical ret builds
 3. alternatively just remove it from the game, thta would be better for the game than the current useless seal and sometimes op but most of the time useless force procc judgement.

L. Paladin bubble is nerfed thats the max rank version that makes you immune to dmg for 12s and reduces your dmg by 50% but you also lose aggro of npcs. there is also the low lvl version that gives 8 secund ommunity and does not allow doing any dmg while active. i suggest changing the low lvl one to a defensive cd.
On Use reduce all dmg received by 50%, and remove all debuffs on cast (doesnt make immune to new debuffs afterwards). allow attacking romaly maybe with 25% less dmg caused. this would also make bubble cancel macros obsolete

There are more issues like the taunt judgement removing seal of wisdom or generally padlin mana issues, but in my opinion these issues are not rly big enough to need changes, paladins doesnt have to be perfect and some flaws are fine, if you can work around them. i think paladins could be sonsidrerd compelte with these changes

author: Bob022
subject: Re: Paladin classchanges 2.0
content_md:
A thought on Ardent Defender:

Ardent Defender is pretty good for one point.  If you're 30 points in Protection anyway, it's a no-brainer. Yes, there are a small handful of raid bosses that can leapfrog it, but in the other 99%+ of the game it's highly effective as a lifesaver, well worth its tiny cost, and I greatly appreciate that it's a passive ability.  This game's busy enough.  I remember the debates over the equivalent ability years ago during TBC (when it cost 5 points, if I recall) and the parses usually demonstrated that it did fair service but was probably overpriced as a 5-point talent.  At 1 point it's fair value.

Problem with Ardent Defender is it's defacto not really a 1 point talent, it's more like a ~7 point talent because the deep Protection tree is fairly weak overall.  Ardent Defender has its place, but ~7 points is a steep cost.  Compounding that is the Paladin's problem with mediocre threat scaling.  A lot of raiding Paladins go heavily into Ret not out of preference, but out of necessity--they have to if they want to have a ghost of a chance of keeping stuff focused on them, especially once their damage-dealers are wearing T2+ gearing.  Perhaps threat scaling can be addressed somewhere in the bottom of the Protection tree?

I agree Anticipation is pretty sorry in its present state.  Only problem I see is--make it good, where am I going to get the points for it?  I feel spread thin already.  An ideal talent tree structure should allow a player to get all his important stuff for about 42-47 points or so, leaving some freebies to play around with.  Not everyone gets that, but that's the ideal.

author: Partyboyza
subject: Protection Paladin Tier set bonuses V1.0
content_md:
Hi, I main a protection paladin (Belriose), and with the implementation of the new spec Tier sets I would like to create a threat where we can post our suggestions to help the devs with ideas.

I would like to invite everybody to offer suggestions and opinions on what do we think the best affixes would work for each Tier set.
I've presented each set bonus with what I consider to be the most valuable stats a protection paladin would need:

 **2 Item sets:**
 1. +2 T1/ +3 T2 / +4 T4 Holy Shield Charges
 2. +3% T1 / +6% T2 / +9% T3 Block chance
 3. +40 T1 / +80 T2 / +120 T3  Block Value
 4. +10 T1 / +20 T2 / + 30 T3 holy Damage on weapon swing
 5. +3% T2 / +6% T2 / +9% T3 Dmg Reduction
 6. +20 T1 Defense ( no point in adding +defense on T2 and T3 since that will be easier to acquire)
 7. Holy Shield charges return mana +50 T1 / +75 T2 / +100 T3  to the party when consumed.

 **4 Item sets:**
 1. +2% T1 / +4% T2 / +6% T3 Dodge Chance
 2. +15% T1 / +20% T2 / +25% T3 SoR Dmg
 3. +5% T1 / +7% T2 / +10% T3 Consecration dmg
 4. +2% T1 / +4% T2 / +5% T3 chance to hit
 5. +20 T1 / + 25 T2 / + 30 T3 damage reduction from all sources (like Blessing of Sanctuary)
 6. +100% T1 / +200% T2 / + 300% T3 increased effect of Blessing of Sanctuary (epic effect for AOE farming)

 **6 Item sets:**
 1. +1 T1 / +2 T2 / +3 T3 enemy targets affected by your Judgements 5yd range
 2. +10% T1 / +10% T2 / +15% T3 Consecration dmg
 3. +15 T1 / +25 T2 / +35 T3 extra stamina to everyone affected by you Devotion Aura ( or auras in general) - like a priest buff
 4. +10T1 / + 20 T2 / + 30 T3 Devotion aura also reduces damage from all sources (like Blessing of Sanctuary, only that new is an aura)
 5. -15% T1 / -20% T2 / - 25% T3 reduced attack speed to anyone affected by your judgements

 **8 Item sets:**
 1. +20 T1 / +30 T2 / +40 T3 extra stamina to everyone affected by you Devotion Aura ( or auras in general) - like a priest buff, doesn't stack with each other
 2. -10% T1 / -15% T2 / -20% T3 reduced attack speed to any enemy affected by your consecration
 3. T3 only Your Divine shield affects your entire party 30 yd range (might be too OP but cool nevertheless)
 4. T1 / T2 / T3  Your divine shield reduces dmg taken by 60%
 5. T3 only When Holy Shield is consumed it damages all nearby enemies 5yd range for half damage
 6. +20mp +25hp T1 / +30mp +40hp T2 / +40mp +50hp T3 to all targets affected by your consecration
 7. +3% T1 / +6% T2 / +9% T3 damage reduction to anyone affected by your devotion aura
 8. Your Holy Shield will taunt an enemy for 3 seconds when used, can also be used without a target
 9. -5% T1 / -8% T2 / -10% T3 damage reduction for 8 seconds after using Holy Shield

Choosing the right set bonuses for each set will be hardest part.

These are just some of my ideas for the Tier set bonuses.
Please give me your opinions and feel free to add your suggestions, I will try and update with your suggestions.
I hope this helps the devs to get some ideas on what would benefit the protection paladin the most.

author: Bob022
subject: Re: What really protection paladin need.
content_md:
Where am I going to get the mana for all those Holy Lights?  My mana bar's always stretched thin enough as it is.

The existing taunt is obviously designed to be able to do the job when necessary in specific encounters that require it, whilst being inferior to warrior/druid taunt otherwise.  Since that's the intent, I don't ask for it to be put on an equal footing with theirs.  The mana and opportunity cost of using it is steep and perhaps excessive, but might not be seen that way if mana income was better.

Serious ranged attacks are problematic from a pvp standpoint (and there's a PvP server now, so such concerns are going to be factored in whether we like it or not) and also go against a knightly class in terms of concept.  One of the defining traits of knights is that they typically eschewed ranged attacked as cowardly and dishonorable.  That's why they don't use bows.   You might argue that engineering also works against the theme of the class--and it does--but that's no reason to abandon the idea entirely.  Exorcism is reserved for uniquely evil creatures that have no honor in the first place therefore its fair game.  Range should therefore remain a weak point for the class.

For my part, I'd like to see better justification for going to 31 Protection.  The deep tree, not necessarily Ardent Defender itself, could use some enhancements.  In particular it ought to offer sufficient threat so that folks don't feel like they have to go 30 ret for Vengeance. I'd be thrilled with better mana return from somewhere or less reliance on using large amounts of mana for building threat--one way or the other, threat generation that correlates better to the mana bar's performance.

I appreciate T-wow's efforts in this area.  We've got to the point where relatively modest tuning changes can put the class where it ought to be--the big jobs are already done.

author: Tasman
subject: Re: What really protection paladin need.
content_md:
Prot tree improvements should be wieved in 3 main directions:

 1.Threat maintenance:
 1.1.Give baseline [Hand of Reckoning], that would be trained at 10 lvl, it's non changed wotlk version.
 1.2.SoJ should reduce targets movement speed to normal, when discharged, like it was in TBC. As for its talent in prot tree, it can be turned in to 33/66/100% chance immobilizing enemy for 2 sec or something else. This also will fix problem with countering high mobility targets like shamans, druids and hunters. (If it will be implemented SoC proc mechanic should be removed).
 1.3.[Reckoning] - make it grant an extra attack, after being hit or shield block, parry, dodge occured. It will fix current contradiction with defese skill and benefit from it.
 1.4.Addition wotlk version of [Avenger's Shield] as 31 point talent, with instant use (TBC version had 1 sec. cast), for burst aggro on multiple targets and easy mob packs pull.

 2.Mana regeneration:
 2.1. [Spiritual Attunement] - 2 point talent at row 6 of prot tree. That will provide paladin with 10% of mana from the amount healed hp. It will improve threat generation with spells, because prots mana drains very fast.
 2.2. Make blessings last 10 min for small and 30 min for big ones, in exchange increase their mana cost by 50%.

 3.Surviability improvements:
 3.1.[Improved Devotion Aura] - add extra 10 defese skill (at rank 5) to this talent and move it, from row 1 to 2. Talents [Precision] and [Guardian's Favour] they should be moved to row 1, to make them more accessible to ret an holy specs.
 3.2.[Toughness] - add bonus that will provide +10 points of resistance to all schools of magic (at rank 5) and make it stack with resistance auras.
 3.3.[Anticipation] - change it from granting 10 of defense (due to defense as a bonus moved to [Improved Devotion Aura]), to 5% of dodge (at rank 5).
 3.3.[Imroved Righteous Fury] - add all damage reduction by 6% (at rank 3).
 3.4.[Blessing of Sanctuary] - double damage reduction on all ranks of this spell and add hp increase bonus: rank 1 - 4%, rank 2 - 6%, rank 3 - 8%, rank 4 - 10% and allow hp bonus to stack with BoK.
 3.5.[Ardent Defender] - make it 3 point talent like it was in wotlk, but at row 6. It will give 7/13/20% damage reduction when below 35% of health and heals paladin for 10/20/30% of his hp when he recieves killing blow. Talent cooldown 2 - 3 min.
 3.6.Change [Divine Protection] - to provide reduction of all incoming damage by 50%.

author: Calli
subject: Re: What really protection paladin need.
content_md:
Why are you suggesting all the time TBC and WOTLK things and all those complicated changes? The class is much better than it was just need a bit of polishing. Changes should be unique. Let paladins use the light to make them tankier and please don't copy warriors and do not take their duty.
By the way in WOTLK deathknights tanked with self healing and it was fine. Paladin here should do the same really.
What do we need?
 1. A deep prot talent that is comparable to the Vengeance build
 2. An ability to survive crits and crushing blows, mitigating damage
 3. if our taunt is a seal's judgement, let it be, but make that seal worth to use for tanking. Changing the seal just to taunt is bad.
What we don't need
 1.Copy warriors
 2.Bring other things from later expansions
 3.Make the prot pala overpowered and change all his talents for good. All classes have talents which not really attractive, but they still have their uses sometimes for some people

Most of suggested changes in my list are unique or just an improvements of already existing ones. About copying warrior. If you mean [Hand of Reckoning] and  [Divine Protection]. Those abilities are essential for tanking classes, which determines their ability officially tank dungeons and raids. There are not so much that can be done with them, because they are the core of tanking mechanic.
And in my opinion [Hand of Reckoning] is unique compared to warriors or druids taunts, because it allows ranged puls and does damage. It is far supperrior to any single target taunt, which warrior or druid has, but for me it is compeletely fair. Due to warrior have 3 taunts and druid 2. And don't tell me about [Rigteous Fury] it is not a taunt. This is an threat maintenance ability. If you can't taunt target with 100% chance, it is threat maintenance. If you can, then it is a taunt.
[Divine Protection] yes, literal warrior's [Shield Wall] in my sggestion list, but in current state it is completely useless ability due to presence if [Divine Shield]. So why not to make it useful for tanking and let paladin be proper tank? Keeping one class downgrated, to make other class look good is bad approach.
We already have exapmle of so called «vanilla stile creative approach» from devs, thet ended with worst implementation of paladins taunt. Which drawbacks I will explain later. So, better stick with blizz way of improvements.

Selfhealing - actually is present in suggested version of [Ardent Defender] which provides it when it is necessary to survive. If you want more of that, this would require to do some talent rework in holy tree Row 2 and 3 talents. Here is some ideas:
Talent [Holy Land] 1 point talent at Row 3, Requires 10 points in Holy Talents - Grants your consecration spell ability to heal you, members of your party and raid if they stand on the consecrated land. Healing occurs every time when damage supposed to be done to the enemies who enter the area (damage and healing effect scales separately from amount of  healling and damage spell power).
Talent [Improved Holy Seals] 5 point talent at Row 2 Requires 5 points in Holy Talents - Icreases damage done by your [Seal of Righteousness], healing gained from [Seal of Light] and mana from [Seal of Wisdom] by 20% (at max rank).

What do we need?
 1.You basically want to cram everithing in one or two talents and expect that it will work out. No it won't, look at how many changes blizz made to make paladins valuable at tanking.
 2.Already suggested in «3.Surviability improvements».
 3.No it should not be SoJ.
There is 6 reasons why it is a bad idea:
 1.It requires 3 talent points to obtain.
 2.You can't get it until you are 27 lvl, where warrior gets [Taunt] at 10 lvl and [Mocking Blow] at 16 lvl, [Challenging Shout] at 26 lvl, Druid gets [Growl] at 10 lvl and [Challenging Roar] at 28 lvl, learning them as baseline spells.
 3.It removes SoW on target effect.
 4.Don't have useful on paladin effect when tanking.
 5.Requires usage of 2 separate abilities in order to taunt.
 6.Overwhelms seal system when tanking. Because seal system effectively can support only 2 seals (which is at current moment SoR and SoW) at one time, third is too much for it.

What we don't need?
 1.Except [Divine Protection], I consider, that all other paladins spells/talents, suggeted in my list are pretty unique and based on TBC and wotlk improvements. Other talents/skill that can be recognised as copypaste from warrior, is made by blizz or turtle devs. Portion of existing talents, that was improved, can't be viewed as copy past from warrior.
 2.To late we already have TBC's version of [Ardent Defender] talent, that by itself was bad, but devs made it even worse, by downgrading damage reduction from 30% to 25%. Blame devs for starting this.
And «vanilla stile creative approach» just don't work and make things pretty complicated and even unusable. So I don't agree with you here.
 3.Those suggestions, came in my mind, with expectation that they would be implemented in same patch with changes for other classes. So if someone consider that paladin will be OP with those changes, go to your class forum section and suggest your ideas.
I don't agree that there should be some useless talents. I suggest idea, to make all talents attractive, which will result in different builds. We don't have too many talents/ablities in each tree here, but we have a lot of problems with current ones being underpowered/useless. You can't improve tanking performance, by retaining them in their current state, with less effort.

And one more, look at SoD. Literal copy past of TBC, wotlk and even Cata abilities/talents thorugh rune mechanic. And a lot of people went there to play from turtle (just look how population decreased on PvP server and even on PVE). That means, people want more class changes.

author: Bob022
subject: Re: What really protection paladin need.
content_md:
I'm not him, and I'm leery of heal-based tanks as a matter of concept, but I'll skip that reservation for now.  A less subjective issue with your proposal for Reckoning is that it's still based on incoming crits, which represents a serious limitation.  In effect it'd be useful only for leveling or PvP since tanks gear for crit immunity in max level PvE content.  If that's the intent, then all's good.

Ardent Defender is a good talent for 1 point.  Yes it can be leapfrogged by sufficiently high hits--it isn't perfect--but it's still a no-brainer at a one point cost if someone's 30 points in Prot anyway.  The TBC version of the talent was a multiple-point talent and hence expensive for what it did.  Turtle's version is good value, and I hugely appreciate that it's passive--combat is busy enough as it is.  The main issue is at present not a lot of paladins want to go 30 points into Protection.  Most of the deep Prot tree is mediocre to bad, and Vengeance over in Retribution is very strong.

Aside from mediocre single target threat, paladin won't be taken seriously as a tank at the high-end, especially not for progression, until the problem of crushing blows is addressed, either by making it realistically possible to reach consistent immunity, or by making Warriors vulnerable to them.

I don't mind the taunt being inferior to Warrior or Druid taunt, but I do mind it costing three points.  That feels like adding insult to injury.

In general the class needs better baseline mana returns.  This can be accomplished within existing mechanics--just the values need tweaking.  The current system of gearing for add-on damage serves as a workaround for now, but it's unsatisfying, "secret" in the game unless another player teaches about it, and clunky besides.
